portfolio.title: And I'm a AI-Driven Software Developer
portfolio.heroBio: Software developer specializing in React, TypeScript, and full-stack web applications with 4 years of experience building scalable systems.
portfolio.aboutBio1: I’m a AI-Driven Software Engineer with about ~5 years of experience building digital products, scalable applications, and user-focused experiences. My background spans frontend engineering, backend development, and enterprise digital platforms. Today, I’m expanding that foundation into AI engineering exploring LLMs, intelligent systems, and agent-based workflows to build smarter, more capable software.
portfolio.aboutBio2: Tel Aviv, Israel · Available for hybrid or remote roles.

experiences.role: AI Engineer - Agentic Workflows & Frontend Platform
bullets: Agent-Driven Development (ADD) & UI Architecture: Architected a spec-to-code pipeline using context engineering and structured agent workflows, adapting official client designs to existing system architecture or engineering new features and solutions for Apple, Samsung, and Google AEM launches.

Frontend Infrastructure & Developer Experience: Built reusable JavaScript utilities (WebView routing, asset paths, event tracking) documented in Confluence and approved by the client Lead Web Architect, pairing them with .cursorrules for 10 developers to slash boilerplate code and AI token costs across 55+ weekly tickets.

AI Workflow & MCP Standardization: Led team-wide adoption of Cursor coding agents, configuring modular rules and MCP toolchains (Figma, DevTools, Bitbucket) to align prompt patterns, prevent AI hallucinations, and standardize delivery.

Automated a11y Guardrails & Performance: Embedded ADA compliance into the agent coding lifecycle using custom AI guardrails and Chrome DevTools validation, maintaining zero Core Web Vitals regressions.
Analytics Infrastructure: Built Adobe Analytics architecture from scratch (20+ events) across e-commerce and Self-Care apps, leading bi-weekly client syncs as the Subject Matter Expert.
Identity & Authentication: Developed frontend OKTA SSO authentication infrastructure across customer-facing e-commerce and self-service applications.
CMS & E-Commerce Integrations: Shipped Drupal CMS modules, feature-flag rollouts, and core integrations including credit checks, device protection, and Google reCAPTCHA bot mitigation.

Mentorship & Engineering Standards: Mentored 2 engineers on cross-application architecture and complex integrations, tripling team delivery capacity while enforcing code quality via strict code reviews.
End-to-End Ownership: Owned core frontend delivery for a UK regulatory telecom provider-switching system, enabling millions of subscribers to seamlessly transfer broadband and mobile services online.
Cross-Platform Feature Delivery: Shipped shared React and TypeScript features (Redux-Saga, MUI) across consumer web, retail tablets, and mobile applications.
Complex UI & Buy-Flows: Delivered broadband compliance flows, card-payment add-ons, and cart redesigns supporting eSIM, number allocation, and spend caps.
Delivered on-site production support at client locations in the UK, supporting release activities, troubleshooting critical issues, and improving technical documentation.
Enterprise Platform Migration: Migrated a major storefront from React and Contentful to Vue.js, Drupal, and PHP on Acquia with zero customer disruption.
Checkout & Cart Architecture: Rebuilt core checkout, cart management, BYOD (Bring Your Own Device), and address validation flows to achieve 100% functional parity.
CMS Module Development: Delivered configurable Drupal CMS storefront modules and comprehensive buy-flow UI redesigns within a strict PI-based Agile cadence.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinated feature grooming, technical specs, and QA validation directly with client stakeholders and Product Owners across two production apps.

recommendations.author: Omri Biton
recommendations.quote:
I had the pleasure of working alongside Matan at Amdocs on the Digital UI program for Altice, where we were both frontend developers on the same customer-facing platform.

Matan is a strong full-stack developer with deep frontend skills. He's highly proficient in React, JavaScript and modern UI tooling. What stands out most is his curiosity and drive to keep improving. He's always among the first to explore new technologies, whether that's upgrading our component tooling or adopting AI-assisted development tools early and showing the team how much time they can save. He did all this while pursuing his degree, which says a lot about his discipline and work ethic.

He contributed to successful deliveries, including an Okta integration demo that was well received. He's also a great teammate. He's generous with his knowledge, always ready to discuss an architecture idea or help debug a tricky configuration, and he's honest and practical when giving advice.

Any team would be lucky to have Matan. I highly recommend him.
